title: Session scan
lead: The folders labhq looks in when it counts your agent sessions. A session whose working folder is outside them is not listed, summarised or analysed, and its conversation is never opened.
load_failed: The scan folders could not be loaded.
machine_wide: No folder is set, so the scan covers the whole machine. Add the folder that holds your projects to narrow it.
passkey_note: Adding or removing a folder changes what labhq reads on this machine, so it asks for your passkey. A change asked for by voice only brings you here.

errors.refused: Your passkey was not accepted. Nothing changed.
errors.invalid: That folder cannot be used. Nothing changed.
errors.not_found: That folder is not one of the scan folders.
errors.failed: That did not work. Try again.
errors.network: labhq could not be reached. Try again.
